comment: The extension registry: namespaced extensions with a spec page, a reference implementation and conformance cases (CONTRIBUTING.md). An extension is experimental until two implementers sign off and a producer ships it.

ext-physics.notes: Three implementations (JS, Rust, Python), all running the same outcome assertions in their CI (npm test here; cargo test -p localgpt-world-physics in LocalGPT). The first package shipped using the extension is examples/the-drop-test. Still experimental until a producer outside this repository ships one. Semantic outcomes are the contract — bit-exact cross-engine trajectories are never promised.
